summary: HZPC is a Dutch company that breeds potato varieties and trades seed potatoes, with its head office in Joure, Friesland. It was formed in 1999 by the merger of Hettema (founded 1898) and ZPC (founded 1919). It is wholly owned by the HZPC Association, whose certificates are held by growers, breeders and staff.
ownership: 100% held by Vereniging HZPC; certificates held by (former) growers, breeders and staff
products: Potato varieties for retail fresh, salad, traditional, French fries and crisps
markets: Representatives in 9 countries, including Bangladesh, Pakistan and South Africa
Agents and distributors in other countries
Segments: Retail Fresh, Traditional, French Fries, Crisps
facts: Minitubers in the Netherlands: 9 million; protected varieties: 130+
R&D investment: EUR 11 million a year; hybrid breeding started in 2011

contact.address: HZPC Holland B.V., Edisonweg 5, 8501 XG Joure, The Netherlands

limitations: The facts and figures page does not give a reference year, and some figures differ between pages.
